lines.text: UG. Ride. Pool. Rent. Deliver.
One app for every way to move in Uganda. Tugende.
In Kampala we check three apps before every trip, and still ask the boda man.
UG puts every way on one screen.
Every quote, ranked by price, and it tells you which ones are estimates.
The button is always Book on UG. Nobody sends you away.
The Virtual Stage. You pay for your seat first, and the price drops as the car fills.
When the money is in, UG makes the trip and hands it to a driver who is comfortable on that road.
Drivers do not chase trips. They say where they are comfortable, once.
Funded offers come to them. Accept, and go.
Rent a Prado for the weekend and split it four ways.
Or arrive in the Signature fleet, and look the part.
Your parcel rides in the boot of the stage car to Jinja.
A quarter of a seat. That is it.
Air, bus, water, rail, Signature, stays. One table.
Four honest states, always on the screen.
The Pearl, priced honestly. The whole weekend in one number.
East African citizens pay East African prices.
Tazama plays in the dock. Pulse shows where the demand is.
Send it to Felt. Talk to it through Cephable.
Whatever you book, the same trip rail carries it to done.
Hakuna anayetumwa mbali. Twende.
Install it. Same crest, same account, same shillings.
UG. Weebale. Tugende.
